name: magnet-resolver
author: mudengke
title: Magnet Link Resolver
description: Turn a page that contains magnet links into a BitTorrent task. Ported from play.py: reads the first magnet in a list item or on the page, understands JSON APIs and info hashes, and uses The Pirate Bay's apibay API for search pages.

settings.name: sites
settings.title: Sites to inspect
settings.description: Comma- or newline-separated domains. Only pages on these hosts are parsed; everything else is left to Gopeed. Use * to inspect every site (slower, and every new task will fetch its page once more).
settings.value: thepiratebay.org, apibay.org, 1337x.to, 1337x.st, x1337x.ws, 1377x.to, torrentgalaxy.to, tgx.rs, nyaa.si, sukebei.nyaa.si, btdig.com, bt4g.org, bt4gprx.com, btsow.com, limetorrents.lol, limetorrents.info, rutracker.org, eztv.re, eztvx.to, magnetdl.com, torlock.com, bitsearch.to, solidtorrents.to, torrentfunk.com, zooqle.com, glodls.to, ext.to, yts.mx, rarbg.to, therarbg.com, libgen.is, libgen.rs, libgen.st, annas-archive.org, fitgirl-repacks.site, dodi-repacks.site

settings.name: userAgent
settings.title: User-Agent
settings.description: User-Agent header used when fetching a page or the apibay API.
settings.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0 Safari/537.36

settings.name: cookie
settings.title: Cookie
settings.description: Optional Cookie header for sites that require a session. Copy it from your browser's developer tools.

settings.name: timeout
settings.title: Request timeout (seconds)
settings.description: How long to wait for a page or API response.
